response.sql: WITH purpose_averages AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM `order` WHERE amount > 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM purpose_averages) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.average_amount, p.average_amount - o.overall_average AS amount_above_overall FROM purpose_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_amount > o.overall_average;

assumptions.assumption: A large order has an amount greater than 2802; the cutoff itself is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is inclusive, large orders have an amount of at least 2802.
